Stumps on the opening day of the 1st Test!

An excellent day with the bat as #TeamIndia reach 359/3 ????

Captain Shubman Gill (127*) and Vice-captain Rishabh Pant (65*) at the crease ????

Scorecard ?? https://t.co/CuzAEnBkyu#ENGvIND pic.twitter.com/kMTaCwYkYo

— BCCI (@BCCI) June 20, 2025

India stamped their authority on Day 1 at Headingley, closing at a dominant 359/3. Openers Jaiswal and KL Rahul gave a strong start with a 91-run stand before India lost two quick wickets—Sudharsan falling to a leg-side strangle just before lunch. What followed was sheer class. Jaiswal and Shubman Gill stitched a flawless, wicketless second session, with both batters looking in complete control. Jaiswal brought up a superb century (101) before departing, handing the baton to Pant (65*), who joined Gill (127*) for another century partnership. Pant reached his fifty and crossed 3000 Test runs, capping a near-perfect day for India.
